remedies.title: Unmask IRQ first in main() and defer recompute_velocity_profile() to a worker thread
remedies.rationale: With InterruptAttachEvent() the kernel masks the interrupt until the thread calls InterruptUnmask(). Work done before that keeps the line masked (later interrupts are delayed or lost) and keeps the highest-priority thread busy. The QNX pattern: acknowledge, unmask, and hand the rest to a lower-priority worker with a pulse.

remedies.title: Slow interrupt response on IRQ 4: a symptom
remedies.rationale: irq latency is the visible effect; the trace also shows its cause (irq_handler_overrun). It is expected to clear with that fix, and the re-trace checks that it does.
